name: mobile-2-touch-targets-44px
js: (()=>{const els=[...document.querySelectorAll('a,button,[role="button"],input,select,textarea')];const bad=[];for(const el of els){const r=el.getBoundingClientRect();const cs=getComputedStyle(el);if(cs.display==='none'||cs.visibility==='hidden'||r.width===0||r.height===0)continue;if(r.width<44||r.height<44)bad.push((el.tagName+'.'+String(el.className).slice(0,30))+':'+Math.round(r.width)+'x'+Math.round(r.height));}return bad.length?bad.length+' SMALL|'+bad.slice(0,8).join(';'):'ALL>=44'})()

name: mobile-3-cta-geometry
js: (()=>{const cta=document.querySelector('.send-circle,[class*="btn-primary"],[class*="cta"]');if(!cta)return 'NO-CTA-FOUND (replace with the actual primary CTA selector)';const r=cta.getBoundingClientRect();const iw=window.innerWidth,ih=window.innerHeight;const inView=r.left>=0&&r.top>=0&&r.right<=iw&&r.bottom<=ih;return 'cta='+Math.round(r.left)+','+Math.round(r.top)+' '+Math.round(r.width)+'x'+Math.round(r.height)+' inView='+(inView?'YES':'NO-RED')})()

name: mobile-4-tap-spacing
js: (()=>{const els=[...document.querySelectorAll('a,button,[role="button"],input,select,textarea')].filter(el=>{const r=el.getBoundingClientRect();const cs=getComputedStyle(el);return cs.display!=='none'&&cs.visibility!=='hidden'&&r.width>0&&r.height>0});let hits=0;const ex=[];const g=4;for(let i=0;i<els.length;i++)for(let j=i+1;j<els.length;j++){const a=els[i].getBoundingClientRect(),b=els[j].getBoundingClientRect();const overlapXY=(a.left-g<b.right&&b.left-g<a.right&&a.top-g<b.bottom&&b.top-g<a.bottom);const contains=els[i].contains(els[j])||els[j].contains(els[i]);if(overlapXY&&!contains){hits++;if(ex.length<5)ex.push(els[i].tagName+'.'+String(els[i].className).slice(0,20)+'<->'+els[j].tagName+'.'+String(els[j].className).slice(0,20));}}return hits?hits+' CLOSE-PAIRS(<8px)|'+ex.join(';'):'NO-CLOSE-PAIRS'})()
